title: Page 7
content_zh:
段柯古站在如意门外接待。“法师不用多礼，您怎么会实然下山来？”
“老尼听到传闻，说如意中了鸩毒……老尼是特别过来看她的。”
“这边请。”段柯古点头。
三人一块到床边，经过半日，如意手上的紫气已过小臂一半。
明慧法师头一点，随行的小尼姑解下行囊，从里边取出一只木盒。
“法师？！”段柯古皱眉。
“请段大人暂且回避。”明慧法师说话：“老尼要帮如意下针放毒。”
太好了！段柯古点头。“那就劳烦法师，柯古先行退下。”
一盏茶时间过，明慧法师用尽盒里银针，解毒的工作暂告一段落。明慧法师要伺候如意的婢女看顾，然后领着小尼姑步出。
“怎么样？”他一脸期盼。
“鸠毒顽强难解，老尼施了几针，总算先压下它的毒气，让它不再往上蔓延。”能压制，已是不幸中的大幸。
“多谢法师出手相救。”说时，段柯古便要跪下磕头。
“阿弥陀佛，老尼受不起如此大礼。”明慧法师连忙拉人。
“不，这个头柯古一定要磕，如意跟我早已经在她娘亲面前互许终身，我们本来是打算等“小莲庄”步上轨道，就拜堂完婚的。”
原来是这样。明慧法师点点头，又想起什么地开口：“但老尼记得如意提过，大人您得回江州？”
段柯古面色一沉。“不敢欺瞒法师，其实再四天，就是最后期限。”
“那如意……”明慧法师一愕。
他明白法师想问什么，他双手抱拳一拜。“柯古有一事要请教法师。”
“您说。”
“如意她现在身子，可禁得起舟车劳顿？”

“不行。”明慧法师毫不考虑。“老尼就不拐弯抹角了，老尼带来的银针，这会儿全插在如意身上，一共得插上两个时辰，每日都得施行这么一次，才能勉强抑下毒气。您想，这种情况下，您想带她上哪儿去？”
“我本是打算雇车把她带到江州，好随身照顾……”
明慧法师摇头。
“行不得，现换老尼有一事相问，可否让老尼带如意上“还朴庵”？等等——”明慧法师按下欲说话的段柯古。“您先听我说，老尼知道大人舍不得，但老尼想，与其冒着生命危险，倒不如留她下来，或许过个一阵找到解药，如意身上鸩毒就能解开了。”
段柯古知道明慧法师说得没错，问题是……“但现在没人敢确定这世上是不是真有犀角粉。”
在周大人帮忙打听下，他才明白犀角粉简直是传说中神物，听过的人不少，但从没人看过它长什么模样。
一直以来，中了鸠毒就等于没了性命，幸好如意服下的毒汤不多，又加上护心丹保命，才有那一线生机。
换句话说，她现是处在随时有可能丧命的情况，如果真不能救醒她……这个可能性刚从脑袋闪过，段柯古马上抹去它。
不会的，如意不会有事的。
他重吸口气。“好，我不带她去江州；换我留下。”
“行不得！”一直在旁偷听的于伯跳出来喊：“您到江州赴任，是皇上亲自任命，您不到，可是欺君大罪！”
“是啊。”明慧法师一听事态严重，也帮忙相劝。“倘若如意醒来知道您做了什么，想必她也不会认同。”
“你们说的我怎么不晓得。”段柯古一脸痛苦。“但我就是……我没有办法丢下她！”
万一，她真在他离开时候出了差错……他不敢想，往后日子，他如何独活！
几人杵在院子里僵持着，没一个想得出两全其美的办法。
这时候，一直待在房内的婢女水盈，悄悄开门唤了声：“大人。”
段柯古猛地转身。“怎么了？”
婢女见他误会，连忙摇手。“小姐她还好，是小的有个东西，希望大人过来看一看。”
“等等……”小尼姑想到如意身上插着银针，衣衫不整，追着要阻止。
明慧法师却拉回她，摇了摇头。“没关系。”

段柯古早跨进房里。
婢女轻轻颔首，然后弯身从衣箱里拿了本子出来，交给他。“这是小姐为大人准备的，大人慢看，小的先到外头等。”
刚才但柯古一番话，水盈全在里边听见了。水盈以前就是如意的婢女，虽然隔了一年没相处，但如意的个性，水盈自认很了解。
就如明慧法师说的，要小姐醒来后发现大人为她犯下大罪，她绝对不会高兴的。
煮饭时加入一些粟米，可以使米饭更为馨香，杀鱼时如何不使鱼肉沾刀？那就得先用鱼腹上的腴油抹刀，或者用鱼脑沾搽也成……
里边每一字句，溢满了对他的叮咛与担心。她实在不希望他到江州赴任后，会因为太思念她做的菜而瘦削憔悴，所以暗暗准备了这子，让读到它的人可以依样制作。
“这个傻丫头……”段柯古蒙住眼，感觉眼泪一下染湿了掌心。
想她在百忙之下，还拨空写这子，他明白水盈让他看这子的用意。他手上这子正在提醒他，他有他得肩负的责任。
“我真的不想放你一个人在这儿……但是……”他一瞧卷握在手心的子，痛苦呻吟道：“我会听你的话到江州去，但你也得答应我，你不可以在我离开这段时间，有任何差错！你绝对不可以让我一个人，孤单的度过下半生，你听到了吗？”
想当然床上人儿没有反应。
但他知道她心里一定是这么想着的，这是她写在子最末的承诺，“中心藏之，何日忘之”。她一定会为了他，撑下去。他相信她一定会醒来，笑着成为他的妻。
段柯古摸了摸她脸颊一会儿，这才步出房间。
门外数人，纷纷转头看他。
“去帮我收拾行李，”他看着于伯吩咐：“我明儿一早就动身到江州。还有，你不用跟来，暂且留下来帮忙照顾“小莲庄”。”
“大人放心，小的一定竭尽心力，绝不会让大人您失望。”于伯大松口气，只要大人愿意到江州去，不管要他做什么都行。
他点点头，然后看着明慧法师，突然曲膝下跪，重重磕了个响头后，抬起湿红的眼睛说道：
“我的妻子如意，就烦劳法师照顾了。”
明慧法师搀起他，应允：“一定。”
第9章(1)
黯然销魂者，唯别而已矣。

上马车前，段柯古还不停叮咛于伯。
“切记，你每天一定要把如意的情况写下，差人快马送到我那儿去。”
于伯再三允：“大人放心，小的绝不敢耽误。”
启程时间已到，他又朝“还朴庵”方向看了最后一眼，这才放下车上竹帘，低语：“动身吧。”
前头的马夫“驾”地喊声，前载人后载行李两辆马车，同时辘辘前行。
此一别，就是来回数百里的相思了。
行前，他提笔写下江淹两句诗——
黯然销魂者，唯别而已矣。
封箴，交给水盈收妥，直待如意苏醒时细看。
每日清早，于伯便会派人到“还朴庵”打听如意消息，再把消息写在纸上，快马送至江州。送信者回来，也会带回段柯古的信箴，里边一定会一有封署名如意。于伯收到，也会立刻派人送上“还朴庵”。
如此鱼雁往返，竟也过了半月有余。
一早，段柯古办妥了公事，他便支退师爷，坐在书房写信给于伯，探问京上打听犀角粉的事情办得怎么样了，怎么这么久没回应？
content_en:
Duan Kegu stood outside Ruyi's door to receive him. "Master, you don't need to be polite, how could you actually come down the mountain?"
"I heard rumors that Ruyi was poisoned... I came here especially to see her."
"Please come this way." Duan Kegu nodded.
The three of them went to the bedside together. After half a day, the purple energy on Ruyi's hand had reached half of his forearm.
Master Minghui nodded, and the accompanying young nun untied her luggage and took out a wooden box from inside.
"Mage?!" Duan Kegu frowned.
"Master Duan, please stay away for now." Master Minghui said: "This old nun wants to help Ruyi administer the poison."
Great! Duan Kegu nodded. "Then please trouble the mage, Ke Gu will retreat first."
After a cup of tea, Master Minghui used up all the silver needles in the box, and the detoxification work came to an end for the time being. Master Minghui wanted to take care of Ruyi's maid, and then led the little nun out.
"How's it going?" He looked hopeful.
"The dove poison is stubborn and difficult to cure. The old nun gave it a few injections and finally suppressed its poisonous energy so that it would no longer spread upward." Being able to suppress it is a great blessing among misfortunes.
"Thank you Master for saving me." As he said this, Duan Kegu knelt down and kowtowed.
"Amitabha, this old nun cannot bear such a great gift." Master Minghui hurriedly pulled people away.
"No, I must bow to this one. Ruyi and I have already made a lifelong promise to each other in front of her mother. We originally planned to wait until "Xiaolianzhuang" is on the right track, and then we will get married."
So that's it. Master Minghui nodded, then remembered something and said, "But I remember Ruyi mentioned that Sir, you have to go back to Jiangzhou?"
Duan Kegu's face darkened. "I don't dare to deceive the mage. In fact, the deadline is in four days."
"Then Ruyi..." Master Minghui was stunned.
He understood what the mage wanted to ask, and he bowed with his hands clasped together. "Kegu has something to ask the mage."
"You said."
"If Ruyi is in good health now, can she withstand the fatigue of traveling and traveling?"
"No." Master Minghui didn't think twice. "I won't beat around the bush. The silver needles I brought are now all inserted into Ruyi's body. They have to be inserted for a total of two hours, and they have to be administered once a day to suppress the poisonous energy. Where do you want to take her in this situation?"
"I originally planned to hire a car to take her to Jiangzhou so that I could take care of her..."
Master Minghui shook his head.
"I can't do that. I have a question about this old nun. Can I ask him to take Ruyi to Huanpu Nunnery? Wait a minute -" Master Minghui pressed down Duan Kegu who was about to speak. "Listen to me first. I know that I am reluctant to let go, but I think that rather than risking my life, it is better to keep her here. Maybe after a while, the antidote is found, and the poison in Ruyi's body can be cured."
Duan Kegu knew that Master Minghui was right, but the problem was... "But no one is sure now whether there is really rhino horn powder in the world."
With Mr. Zhou's help in inquiring, he realized that rhinoceros horn powder was a legendary creature. Many people had heard of it, but no one had ever seen what it looked like.
Until now, being poisoned by dove poison was equivalent to losing your life. Fortunately, Ruyi only took a small amount of poisonous soup and added the Heart-Protective Pill to save his life, so he had a glimmer of hope.
In other words, she was now in a situation where she could die at any time. If she couldn't be saved... As soon as this possibility flashed through his mind, Duan Kegu immediately erased it.
No, Ruyi will be fine.
He took a deep breath. "Okay, I won't take her to Jiangzhou; I'll stay instead."
"No way!" Yu Bo, who had been eavesdropping, jumped out and shouted: "You went to Jiangzhou to take up the post. It was appointed by the emperor himself. If you don't come, it will be a serious crime of deceiving the emperor!"
"Yes." When Master Minghui heard that the situation was serious, he also helped to persuade him. "If Ruyi wakes up and knows what you have done, she will probably not agree with it."
"Why don't I know what you are talking about?" Duan Kegu looked pained. "But I just...I can't leave her!"
What if she really made a mistake when he left...he wouldn'tDare to think about how he will live alone in the future!
Several people stood in a stalemate in the yard, and no one could think of a way to get the best of both worlds.
At this time, Shui Ying, the maid who had been staying in the room, quietly opened the door and called: "Sir."
Duan Kegu turned around suddenly. "What's wrong?"
Seeing that he misunderstood, the maid quickly waved her hand. "Miss, she's fine. She just has something. I hope adults can come and take a look."
"Wait a minute..." The little nun thought of Ruyi having silver needles stuck in her body and her clothes were disheveled, so she chased after him to stop him.
Master Minghui pulled her back and shook his head. "It doesn't matter."
Duan Kegu stepped into the room early.
The maid nodded slightly, then bent over and took out the notebook from the suitcase and handed it to him. "The young lady has prepared this for the adults. Please wait while the young ones wait outside."
Shui Yingquan heard what Dan Kegu said just now. Shui Ying used to be Ruyi's maid. Although they haven't gotten along with each other for a year, Shui Ying thinks she understands Ruyi's personality very well.
Just like Master Minghui said, Miss Yao will never be happy when she wakes up and finds that adults have committed serious crimes for her.
Adding some corn when cooking can make the rice more fragrant. How can you prevent fish meat from sticking to the knife when killing fish? Then you have to first use a spatula with the fat on the fish belly, or dip it in the fish brain...
Every word in it is filled with warnings and worries for him. She really didn't want him to become thin and haggard after he took up his post in Jiangzhou because he missed her cooking too much, so she secretly prepared this recipe so that people who read it could make it accordingly.
"This silly girl..." Duan Kegu covered his eyes and felt tears wet his palms.
Thinking that she still found time to write this post despite her busy schedule, he understood Shui Ying's intention of letting him read this post. The child in his hand was reminding him that he had responsibilities that he had to shoulder.
"I really don't want to leave you here alone...but..." He looked at the hand in his hand and groaned in pain: "I will listen to your words and go to Jiangzhou, but you also have to promise me that you can't make any mistakes while I'm away! You absolutely can't let me spend the rest of my life alone, do you hear me?"
Of course the person on the bed didn't respond.
But he knew that she must be thinking so in her heart. This was the promise she wrote at the end of the poem, "Hide it in the heart, and never forget it." She will definitely hold on for him. He believed that she would wake up and become his wife with a smile.
Duan Kegu touched her cheek for a while and then walked out of the room.
Several people outside the door turned to look at him.
"Go and help me pack my luggage," he looked at Uncle Yu and ordered, "I will leave for Jiangzhou early tomorrow morning. Also, you don't need to come with me. You can stay and help take care of "Xiaolian Village" for the time being."
"Don't worry, sir. I will do my best and will never let you down." Yu Bo breathed a sigh of relief. As long as you are willing to go to Jiangzhou, you can do whatever you ask him to do.
He nodded, then looked at Master Minghui, suddenly knelt down on his knees, kowtowed heavily, raised his wet red eyes and said:
"My wife is happy, so I'll ask the Master to take care of her."
Master Minghui helped him up and said, "Definitely."
Chapter 9(1)
Those who are in ecstasy can only say goodbye.
Before getting on the carriage, Duan Kegu kept urging Uncle Yu.
"Remember, you must write down your wishes every day and send someone to send it to me quickly."
Uncle Yu promised again and again: "Don't worry, sir, I won't dare to delay you."
It was time to set off, and he took one last look in the direction of "Huan Pu'an", then lowered the bamboo curtain on the car and whispered: "Let's set off."
The groom in front shouted "drive", and the two carriages, carrying people in the front and luggage in the back, rumbled forward at the same time.
This farewell is a longing for hundreds of miles back and forth.
Before leaving, he wrote down two lines of Jiang Yan's poem -
Those who are in ecstasy can only say goodbye.
Feng Zhi, handed it over to Shui Ying for safe keeping until Ruyi wakes up and takes a closer look.
Every morning, Yu Bo wouldSend someone to "Huan Pu'an" to inquire about Ruyi's news, write the news on paper, and quickly send it to Jiangzhou. When the messenger comes back, he will also bring back a letter from Duan Kegu, and there will definitely be a letter signed by Ruyi inside. When Yu Bo receives it, he will immediately send someone to "Huan Pu'an".
It took more than half a month for fish and geese to go back and forth like this.
In the morning, after Duan Kegu had finished his business, he sent his master away and sat in his study to write a letter to Uncle Yu, asking how the capital's inquiry about rhinoceros horn powder went, and why there was no response for so long?
